properties.evidence: Settled at option E, but the OPEN half — whether the allocation step needs a skill, and what that skill would teach — cannot be answered before that node is. Options A/B/C all describe a method whose first step is propose_allocation, which that node shows is the PERFORMANCE graph specifically; reliability wants no articulation points and may duplicate a function, maintainability wants co-change, security wants constrained partitioning. Until the ility question is answered, any allocation skill silently picks one.
